title: 第15章 可以根治第16章 宋萌萌担心
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳笑了笑，语气含糊：“梅姐，这是我的秘密，不方便透露。”
柳醉梅眼神一亮，身体微微前倾，语气急切问：“你……你是修炼者？”
陈阳愣了一下，心里奇怪：修炼者是什么？难道这世上真的有修炼者？
他当即想起了给自己传输功法的老道长，还有自己修炼的阴阳功、激活的透视眼神通。
如果这世上没有修炼者，那他身上的这些东西，又都是从哪里来的？
一个念头瞬间在他脑海中升起：说不定眼前这个高高在上的梅姐，见过真正的修炼者，也接触过普通人无法接触到的人和事。
他定了定神，语气恭敬说：“梅姐，我的身份比较特殊，很多事情不方便透露太多，还望你谅解。”
柳醉梅听到这话，脸上瞬间露出激动的神色，眼神里满是敬畏。
她连忙从沙发上站起来，对着陈阳抱了抱拳，语气恭敬至极：“陈高人，刚才多有得罪，还请高人恕罪。”
她转头看向身边的桃夭，桃夭也立刻反应过来，连忙对着陈阳抱拳行礼，语气恭敬：“高人，刚才是我鲁莽了，还请高人见谅。”
陈阳看着两人突如其来的恭敬，心里也明白了几分。
她们果然接触过修炼者，也知道修炼者的厉害。
这也更加印证了，这世上真的有修炼者存在。
他摆了摆手，语气平淡：“没事，不知者不怪，你们也不用这么客气。”
顿了顿，他又补充道：“不过梅姐，你这病只是暂时缓解了，还没有完全断根。
想要彻底根治，还需要用特殊的手法才行。”
柳醉梅闻言，脸上的激动更甚，连忙说：“陈高人，我这痛经已经伴随我十多年了，现在发作得越来越严重，我早就受够了这种痛苦。
只要你能治好我的病，你要多少钱尽管开口，不管是多少，我都能满足你！”
陈阳轻轻摇了摇头，语气认真：“梅姐，这不是钱的问题，而是需要你配合我治疗，否则，就算我有办法，也治不好你的病。”
柳醉梅皱了皱眉，脸上露出几分疑惑：“陈高人，不知道你要我怎么配合你？只要能治好我的病，不管是什么要求，我都能配合。”

陈阳的目光落在一旁的桃夭身上，没有说话。
柳醉梅瞬间明白了他的意思，当即向桃夭使了个眼色。
桃夭脸色微变，眼神里满是不舍和担忧，却还是点了点头，转身走出了大厅，轻轻关上了房门，将空间彻底留给了陈阳和柳醉梅。
柳醉梅上前一步，眼神急切地看着陈阳，语气诚恳：“陈高人，现在没人了，你要我怎么配合你治疗？你尽管说，我一定照做。”
陈阳看着她，语气认真说：“梅姐，你这是纯阴体质引发的身体不适，体内阴寒之气过重，想要彻底化解你体内的阴寒毒气，就必须找一个纯阳体质的男人。
通过阴阳融合，才能彻底根治。”
柳醉梅愣了一下，随即急切问：“陈高人，那你要我去哪里找这样的纯阳体质男人？我从来没有听说过谁是纯阳体质。”
陈阳看着她，嘴角微微上扬，语气笃定：“你不用找，我就是纯阳体质。”
柳醉梅瞬间激动起来，眼神里满是惊喜，连忙说：“陈高人，既然这样，那你快给我治疗！不过你说要我配合你，到底是要怎么配合？”
content_en:
Chen Yang smiled and said in a vague tone: "Sister Mei, this is my secret and it's not convenient to reveal it."
Liu Zuimei's eyes lit up, her body leaned forward slightly, and she asked urgently: "You...are you a cultivator?"
Chen Yang was stunned for a moment, wondering: What is a cultivator? Are there really practitioners in this world?
He immediately thought of the old Taoist master who transmitted the exercises to him, as well as the Yin and Yang skills he had practiced and the clairvoyance he had activated.
If there are no cultivators in this world, where do all these things in him come from?
A thought suddenly arose in his mind: Maybe the aloof Sister Mei in front of him has seen real practitioners and been exposed to people and things that ordinary people cannot.
He composed himself and said in a respectful tone: "Sister Mei, my status is quite special. It is not convenient for me to reveal too much about many things. I hope you can forgive me."
When Liu Zuimei heard this, her face instantly showed excitement, and her eyes were filled with awe.
She quickly stood up from the sofa, hugged Chen Yang, and said in a very respectful tone: "Master Chen, I have offended you a lot just now, please forgive me."
She turned to look at Tao Yao beside her. Tao Yao also reacted immediately and quickly saluted Chen Yang with fists in his hands and a respectful tone: "Master, I was reckless just now. Please forgive me."
Chen Yang saw the sudden respect between the two people and understood something in his heart.
As expected, they have come into contact with cultivators and know how powerful they are.
This further proves that there really are cultivators in this world.
He waved his hand and said in a calm tone: "It's okay. If you don't know, don't blame me. You don't have to be so polite."
After a pause, he added: "But Sister Mei, your disease has only been temporarily relieved, and it has not been completely eradicated.
If you want to completely cure it, you need to use special techniques. "
Hearing this, Liu Zuimei's face became even more excited, and she quickly said: "Master Chen, my dysmenorrhea has been with me for more than ten years, and now it's getting more and more serious. I've long had enough of this pain.
As long as you can cure my disease, just ask for any amount you want, no matter how much it is, I can satisfy you! "
Chen Yang shook his head gently and said in a serious tone: "Sister Mei, this is not a matter of money, but you need to cooperate with my treatment. Otherwise, even if I have a way, I won't be able to cure your disease."
Liu Zuimei frowned, with some confusion on her face: "Master Chen, I don't know how you want me to cooperate with you? As long as my disease can be cured, I can cooperate with you no matter what the request is."
Chen Yang's eyes fell on Taoyao beside him and he said nothing.
Liu Zuimei instantly understood what he meant and immediately winked at Taoyao.
Tao Yao's face changed slightly, her eyes full of reluctance and worry, but she still nodded, turned and walked out of the hall, gently closed the door, leaving the space completely to Chen Yang and Liu Zuimei.
Liu Zuimei took a step forward, looked at Chen Yang eagerly, and said in a sincere tone: "Master Chen, there is no one here anymore, how do you want me to cooperate with your treatment? Just say it, I will definitely do it."
Chen Yang looked at her and said in a serious tone: "Sister Mei, your physical discomfort is caused by your pure yin constitution. The yin and cold energy in your body is too heavy. If you want to completely resolve the yin and cold poisonous energy in your body, you must find a man with a pure yang constitution.
Only through the fusion of yin and yang can a complete cure be achieved. "
Liu Zuimei was stunned for a moment, and then asked eagerly: "Master Chen, where do you want me to find a man with such a pure Yang physique? I have never heard of anyone with a pure Yang physique."
Chen Yang looked at her, the corners of his mouth raised slightly, and his tone was firm: "You don't have to look for me, I have a pure Yang physique."
Liu Zuimei became excited instantly, her eyes full of surprise, and she quickly said: "Master Chen, if this is the case, then give me treatment quickly! But you said you want me to cooperate with you, how exactly do you want me to cooperate?"
